title: Period Matrix and Exact Hodge Metric on the Genus-3 Quaternion Cover

scope.frame: Canonical abelian differentials on the genus-3 superelliptic quaternion cover w^4 = 4x^3 - g_2(tau_*) x - g_3(tau_*) at arithmetic apex tau_* = (1+i*sqrt(84))/3
scope.object: exact numerical integration of the 3x3 period matrix M and deduction of the exact Hodge matter metric K_{1,1} = 2 Im(tau_*) = 6.1101, K_{1,{2,3}} = 0, deriving physical singlet matter normalization N_1 = 0.4046 and geometric mass hierarchy without continuous parameters (P-395)
scope.hypotheses: Quaternion cover Y of genus 3; Q_8 deck transformations; Weierstrass elliptic curve E_{tau_*}; Hodge L^2 pairing on canonical differentials

claim_one_line: PERIOD MATRIX AND EXACT HODGE METRIC (P-395): on the genus-3 cover w^4 = 4x^3 - g_2 x - g_3 at tau_* = (1+i*sqrt(84))/3, numerical path integration between branch roots e_1 = 6.5797, e_2,3 = -3.2899 +/- 0.0046i yields a strictly non-singular 3x3 period matrix with |det(M)| = 6.4276; the singlet norm is identically K_{1,1} = 2 Im(tau_*) = 6.1101 with elliptic period 1.000000, while off-diagonals K_{1,2} = K_{1,3} = 0 vanish by central parity, deriving the physical singlet matter normalization N_1 = (2 Im tau_*)^(-1/2) = 0.4046 and the geometric 1+2 mass hierarchy from first-principles curve geometry.
weave_or_thread: weave (numerical period matrix and exact Hodge matter metric on genus-3 quaternion cover)
